name: Gangtok, Darjeeling, East and North Sikkim trip
route: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra → Gangtok → EAST SIKKIM → Gangtok → Lachung → Yumthang VALLEY and ZERO POINT → Lachung → Gangtok → Darjeeling from Gang → TIGER HILL and OTHER

itinerary.title: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra
itinerary.desc: pickup from RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS Reach Ganotok Check in Hotel Hotel on MG ROAD (no extra travelling cost) Visit MG MARG and LAL MARKET in 1 min walk East Sikkim feels like the mountains whispering stories only slow travelers can hear

itinerary.title: Gangtok to EAST SIKKIM-trip
itinerary.desc: Visit the magical Tsomgo lake, Experience highest ropeway in Asia (14,000 ft ) Nathula Pass (Indo China border) Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir Back to Gangtok Stay in Gangtok "Snowy destinations remind us that even the coldest places can feel magica"

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung
itinerary.desc: Enroute SEVEN SISTER waterfalls and AMITABH BACHCHAN waterfalls stay in Lachung

itinerary.title: Yumthang VALLEY and ZERO POINT
itinerary.desc: Experience Yumthang valley (valley of Flowers-feb to june) SNOW covered ZERO POINT like never before snow season-nov to march/april) stay in Lachung

itinerary.title: Lachung to Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Reach Gangtok by 2PM and local sightseeing Stay in Gangtok Darjeeling feels like breathing deeper."

itinerary.title: Reach Darjeeling from Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Check into the hotel. Enjoy local cafes and food Darjeeling town. Go for Toy Train Ride and evening will be for leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling

itinerary.title: TIGER HILL and OTHER LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.desc: Start your day early morning at 3 am. First point will be the Tiger Hill and then we will visit the Batasia Loop & the Tea Garden. Visit Local sightseeing like Ghoom Monastery, Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Peace Pagoda. Stay in Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Deparcher for
itinerary.desc: N.JP/Bagdogra/Siliguri drop to RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS
